title: Design the lean factory
acceptance: A representative artifact shows one end-to-end task lifecycle.
Stakeholder agreement records a revision, scope, and conditions.
source: Jeremy: develop the environment through recursive tasks

children.title: Sketch the task journey
acceptance: Show idea intake, template selection, subtasks, design review, approved build, and verification using one factory improvement as the example.

evidence.result: Eight-step journey covers intake, design iterations, scoped approval, implementation, validation, and follow-up tasks.

children.title: Mock up tasks and detail view
acceptance: Demonstrate nested tasks, selection, status, dependencies, and linked artifacts.
Include empty, waiting-for-review, failed-run, and completed examples; label simulated content.

evidence.result: DOM checks passed for selection and empty/failed/completed states. Visual review remains with Jeremy; browser automation unavailable.

children.title: Mock up the review loop
acceptance: Demonstrate comments anchored to a proposal revision and how an agent would address them.
Show approval for a bounded slice and a changed design returning to review.

evidence.result: DOM-tested task/revision anchored comments, simulated acknowledgment, scoped approval, and invalidation after a material change.

children.title: Iterate and agree on a slice
acceptance: Present the combined artifact to Jeremy, revise from actual feedback, and record explicit agreement on revision and scope.
Capture behavior that the mockup cannot express in a companion spec.

evidence.result: Concrete review artifact and questions prepared; mockup at http://127.0.0.1:55267/factory.html

children.blocked_reason: Awaiting Jeremy's review of design revision 1 and decision on the first slice. No approval inferred from the self-improvement request.

blocked_reason: Design work complete for revision 1; LF-5 awaits stakeholder feedback and scoped agreement.

title: Prototype the agreed slice
acceptance: One factory improvement runs through the agreed flow using native tools.
Results and remaining gaps trace back to the approved artifact.

children.title: Prototype durable task state
acceptance: Demonstrate parent/child tasks, dependency checks, artifact references, and recovery after closing a pane.
Refine scope from the approved artifact before starting.

children.title: Prototype native agent handoff
acceptance: Demonstrate one explicit task handoff to a native agent CLI in a worktree, with task/run/artifact linkage.
Confirm the chosen agent and execution scope before launching; pane IDs are not task IDs.

children.title: Try Radicle feedback round-trip
acceptance: Use a private local review record for an actual factory artifact revision and retrieve its feedback.
Demonstrate the approved feedback mapping without public publication or fabricated stakeholder comments.

children.title: Use the factory to improve itself
acceptance: Choose a real follow-up improvement discovered during the prototype and capture it as a child task.
Exercise the approved workflow and record what should change in tools or skills.

title: Fix terminal tab and live task status
acceptance: F3 opens a regular shell where Neovim can be launched and exited.
The sidebar identifies active tasks from tasks.json.
The orchestrator persists status transitions before starting work and after outcomes.
evidence: bin/artifact-viewer: F3 launches a login shell at the project root; verified live zsh pane.
bin/task-list: verified Working: LF-11 while this task was active.
skills/factory-orchestrator/SKILL.md: explicit persisted lifecycle transitions; validator passed.
source: Jeremy: terminal in place of Neovim and visible active task

title: Compare cmux in Ghostty
acceptance: A separate Ghostty tab hosts cmux TUI with the task list, terminal, document views, and monitor where supported.
Both workspaces share task and artifact files; existing tmux work remains available.
evidence: cmux TUI binary SHA-256 checked against vendor manifest; local state under .playground/cmux.
Ghostty tab tab-77456c6000 created; cmux control API confirms attached TUI and six terminal tabs.
Layout ratios adjusted to narrow task sidebar and lower-right CPU pane.
source: Jeremy: run the same setup in cmux in another Ghostty tab
